Siemens-Allis
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be performed 
every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block

Vertical 6.3 kv motor of Circulate
water pump 900 HP, ANV & Condensate water pump,1650HP, DP

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed EL-husany, tested by eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director 
eng. Nady Mossaed, approved by
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha CEPC quality control director, 
and certified by eng. AfafEbrahim El Dib, CEPC inspection & quality control 's 
head sector & MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precaution

items:
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category.

Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.

Safety
 fence like ropes with caution marks surrounding the work area .

After
 stopping the motor insure that circuit breaker of the motor is draw out .
Avoid contact with rotating parts

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Electrical toolbox
Vibration monitor

Grease
 - gun

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Check the running conditions (while the motor in service ):

Check the motor vibration not to exceed
60 microns .

Check that there is no abnormal noise on
the motor .

Check the bearing temp. on the accurex in
the control room not to exceed 87 C .

Check the motor stator temp. on the
accurex in the control room not to exceed 150 C .

Check the motor current reading of the 3
phases in the control room .
Check for any oil leak

sections.text:
After isolation the circuit
breaker of the motor
Tighten loosen bolts
Check ground wire, Tighten if necessary

Check oil level for upper bearing , increase if necessary type EDT 
heavy

Remove inlet & outlet plugs and
grease the lower motor bearing with (GED6A2C5) grease then replace inletplug .
Check and clean intake and outlet air filters

Run the motor for 10 minutes before replacing the outlet plug and 
recheck the running conditions
